text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer is here—an unforgettable season for us both.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's right. That fateful event happened last summer…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …What? I've been in bad health because I've been taking on too much by myself?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry, Trainer! From here on out, we do things together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek's health improved after we started sharing responsibilities and became a true team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And we've continued to grow closer ever since. This year…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You look different somehow. Maybe it's because you've gained a bit of muscle since last year?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No, that's not the only reason. You've got a more resolute look in your eye too…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It kind of gives me mixed feelings. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh. Like, I want things to stay how they were, but it also makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But I don't think these changes will stop. Not in you or in me—or in our relationship either.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm not afraid though. I believe we'll be okay no matter how much we change.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Now then! How should we spend this summer in preparation for the fall G1 races?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although we may be closer than ever, some things just never change.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I pledge to the blue skies above to race through this once-in-a-lifetime summer without any regrets.
